name: repo-platform-sync-pr
description: Handle an automated repo-platform sync PR: read the report, clear every row, keep local content in its owned place, and follow the failure path.

interface.shortDescription: Review and repair repo-platform sync PRs.
interface.longDescription: The playbook for the sync PRs repo-platform pushes into managed repositories: the report sections and hold reasons, the manual review cases (replaced local edits, held retirements, replaced mirrors, registration notes), the repo-owned tail of a split file, where a local change lives, and the sync-failed issue a red run files.
defaultPrompt: Handle the repo-platform bot PR that just arrived.
The sync PR says hold for review - clear it.
The sync PR replaced my local edits.
